children: Lista DAO has introduced Yield Mode on Four.meme, a new OpenFour mode that routes a share of launch trading tax into Lista yield products such as the U Vault. Tokens that graduate from the launchpad settle their liquidity on Lista DEX by default, connecting BNB Chain meme launches directly to Lista's infrastructure.

The integration makes Lista DEX the default liquidity settlement venue for every Four.meme graduated token, so launchpad success translates into trading activity and fee flow on Lista. The routed tax share feeds Lista yield products, adding a recurring source of deposits tied to launchpad volume. The size of this effect depends on how many Four.meme launches adopt the mode and how many tokens graduate, so the benefit to LISTA is real but unquantified.

Through ListaYield, launch trading tax flows into Lista yield products (U Vault), and graduated tokens settle their liquidity on Lista DEX by default.
More launches, more yield, more to come 👇

title: Lista DAO: Yield Mode on Four.meme Routes Launch Tax to Lista Yield Products - 03 Sep 2026
